hooks.command: cd "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR" || exit 1; [ -t 0 ] || event=$(cat); build=$(cargo build --quiet --all-targets </dev/null 2>&1) || { printf 'detent: the tree does not build, so no gate ran:\n%s\n' "$build" >&2; mkdir -p target && : > target/.detent-build-blocked; exit 2; }; printf '%s' "$event" | cargo run --quiet -- gate --hook --changed
